body: Endless Ocean is Arika's Wii diving adventure set in the fictional Manaurai Sea. Guided by Katherine Sunday, the player explores underwater environments, identifies marine life and searches for sunken objects. Fish, dolphins and much larger animals give each destination another reason to linger. The structure makes observation the central activity of a diving game: learning what lives in a place and finding a route through its surroundings matter more than reaching a finish line. A boat provides a base from which another stretch of sea can be explored.

The Manaurai setting contains caves, wrecks, shallow areas and deeper trenches, bringing several forms of underwater exploration into one connected adventure. Discovering animals adds to the player's knowledge of the sea, and identified species can populate an aquarium. Dolphins and other cetaceans can become companions and learn behaviours. These activities encourage repeated visits with a different purpose each time. A route first followed to reach a location may later be worth revisiting because a particular animal, object or unfamiliar part of the environment has drawn attention.

Hayley Westenra contributes songs to the game, including Prayer and a performance of Pokarekare Ana. Their presence gives the quiet movement through the sea a distinct musical identity. Players can also provide MP3 files on an SD card for their own listening during a dive. The soundtrack becomes part of how an exploration is remembered: a slow passage beside a large animal or through an unfamiliar space acquires its own accompaniment. Endless Ocean leaves room for those encounters to become the memorable events of the journey.
